versions.content: If supported by hardware, CanTrcv_Init shall validate whether there has been a wake up due to transceiver activity and if TRUE, reporting Specification of CAN Transceiver Driver AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 34 of 84 Document ID 71 : AUTOSAR_SWS_CANTransceiverDriver shall be done to EcuM via API EcuM_SetWakeupEvent with the wakeup source re f- erenced in CanTrcvWakeupSourceRef .
